description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of different multilingual BERT models (mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, XLM-B2) on various linguistic features (case, gender, tag, number, tense) across languages. The vertical axis represents the effect, measured in a numerical scale, while the horizontal axis categorizes the linguistic features. Each bar represents the effect of a model on a specific feature, with varying heights indicating the magnitude of the effect. The bars are color-coded to distinguish between the different models. The chart includes error bars, suggesting variability or confidence intervals around the effect measurements. The effect values range from negative to positive, with some models showing a positive effect and others a negative effect on certain features. The chart does not provide specific numerical values or units for the effect measurements.
